product.title: Brava Barrel Tile
product.description: Brava Barrel Tile is an eco-friendly, fully sustainable composite roofing product made from recycled materials. It combines the timeless beauty of Spanish roof tile with extreme durability and practicality. The synthetic barrel tile provides the classic Mediterranean look of clay tile without the drawbacks of traditional barrel tile, including excessive weight and the need for additional structural support.

specs.name: Wind Resistance
specs.value: All tiles are manufactured to uphold the highest quality control standards and withstand the harshest of weather conditions. Brava tiles are tested and approved to withstand wind speeds of up to 188MPH with ring shank nails and up to 211MPH with high wind / screw installation.

features: Composite roofing tiles are a lightweight alternative to traditional barrel clay tile.
Available in brown, black, and several clay variations.
Class C fire rating with standard underlayments.
